red_flags: Only ~5 written Google reviews; total 6-7 ratings, so star average (3.7-3.9) is dragged down by unwritten low ratings whose reasons are not visible.
One reviewer openly rebuts earlier negative reviewers ('ik weet niet wat deze mensen die reviews hebben geplaatst denken'), confirming critical raters exist but their text was not retrievable.
No independent verified-review platform (klantenvertellen / Kiyoh / Trustpilot) page exists for this school.
Some web results conflate this school with an unrelated instructor 'Heinz' on RijLESS.nl (Den Haag/Vlaardingen) — those reviews were excluded as not belonging to this school.
Reviews are old (mostly 4-10 years ago); little recent feedback.
review_summary: The handful of written Google reviews are positive: students praise flexible scheduling and passing quickly, often after failing at other schools, for car, scooter and motorbike. However the corpus is thin (about 5 short written reviews, all years old), unverified, and the ~3.7 star average implies low ratings whose text is not visible, so trust is weak.
